description: PlaceSchema verification. POST /v1/verify-grant {grant, holder?} checks a signed item grant (Nostr kind-30080 event) offline and returns valid, holder, minter, item hash, type, label and licensed sources. POST /v1/verify-place {url} checks a known PlaceSchema origin's /.well-known/placeschema.json (and place.md) and returns what items it accepts. POST /v1/stash {holder, grants?} lists the items a key reports as deposited or redeemed, verifying grants where it can. JSON in and out; bad input is 4xx, never 5xx. Free.

rpc_types.backend_hint: Caddy proxy (placeschema/backend) to the Cloudflare Worker at https://verify.placeschema.com
rpc_types.notes: GET /v1/version, GET /v1/health, GET /openapi.json, POST /v1/verify-grant, POST /v1/verify-place and POST /v1/stash.

serving.backend: The placeschema/verify Worker behind a RelayMiner using the rest backend.
serving.notes: POST /v1/* is limited to 60 requests per 60 s per client IP; relays share the supplier's IP, so this is the cap per supplier.
